rca_of_the_issue: Original defect: '.mobile-brand{display:none}' declared on App.css line 8 (after the max-width:780px media query on line 7) won the cascade due to equal specificity + later source order, so the mobile logo never rendered. Fix applied by main agent raised specificity inside the media query ('.login-visual .mobile-brand{display:flex;margin-bottom:20px}' and '.login-panel .desktop-brand{display:none}'), which now correctly beats the later default rule. Confirmed fixed.
